purpose: Focused official-executable probes for guide/source discrepancies after complete CO schema coverage.

probes.question: Does the official executable accept, overwrite, or reject a repeated OZONEFIL for one sector?
probes.result: Two distinct-sector OZONEFIL records completed successfully. Two different files assigned to the same sector were rejected with CO E501 from O3FILE.

probes.question: Does the official executable accept, overwrite, or reject a repeated NOX_FILE for one sector?
probes.result: Two distinct-sector NOX_FILE records completed successfully. Two different files assigned to the same sector were rejected with CO E501 from NOXFILE.

probes.question: How does the official executable handle repeated ARCFTOPT and more than one payload field?
Which final diagnostic is emitted for incomplete temporal vectors by flag and scope?
probes.result: Complete global and sector-scoped MONTH vectors were accepted. An 11-of-12 O3VALUES vector was rejected with CO E261, and an 11-of-12 NOX_VALS vector was rejected with CO E603. Sector diagnostics identify O3SECTn or NOXSCTn. The official source uses the same accumulated-count versus flag-derived-required-maximum branches for supported temporal flags.
probes.boundary: The official executable cases use MONTH as the representative time flag; cross-flag behavior is supported by the retained source branches and the existing flag-specific cardinality table rather than by enumerating every flag through the executable.
